meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Phase 09.1 Historical Visualization Integrity, Accessibility & Narrative QA

checks: explicit temporal axis or period context
approximate/disputed dates use ranges or uncertainty labels
parallel tracks remain comparable and labeled
Timeline.rule: No false precision: unknown or approximate dates cannot be rendered as exact points unless the source supports that precision.

Connections.rule: Dense graphs must collapse into focused neighborhoods, grouped summaries or accessible lists rather than unreadable hairballs.

Event Playback.rule: Animation cannot imply causality, simultaneity or certainty beyond what the evidence supports.

Evidence Visualization.rule: Evidence graphics support understanding but never replace access to the underlying source/citation.

checks: missing values not converted to zero
Quantitative Charts.rule: Any non-zero bar baseline, normalization, index, aggregation or derived measure requires explicit explanation where it could affect interpretation.

checks: spatial graphics are contextual evidence rather than background decoration
Historical Maps.rule: Uncertain borders, routes or extents must never be rendered with the same certainty treatment as verified geography.

Uncertainty & Dispute.rule: Epistemic state is content, not decoration, and must survive grayscale, reduced motion and theme changes.

checks: timeline density reduced without deleting evidence
Mobile Density.rule: Mobile may reduce simultaneous density but cannot remove uncertainty, provenance, relationship type or factual context.

checks: map movement not required for meaning
Reduced Motion.rule: Motion may explain progression, but all factual meaning must remain in the static state.

checks: one primary question/thesis per visual story
ending answers what changed / why it matters / explore next
narrative_integrity.rule: Do not stack multiple independent charts/graphs merely because data exists; every visualization must answer a specific editorial question.

rules: Important charts/diagrams provide a concise textual summary or accessible data alternative.
Interactive nodes/points expose keyboard- or assistive-technology-reachable detail where interaction exists.
Essential lines, markers and boundaries meet Phase 02 contrast requirements against adjacent surfaces.
Color is never the sole encoding for category, certainty, direction or state.
Labels reflow and may progressively disclose; they may not shrink below locked Phase 03 readability tokens.
Reduced-motion/static alternatives preserve the full factual message.

production_rules: Historical time graphics never display more temporal precision than the underlying source supports.
Relationship graphs use typed edges and progressive disclosure; dense hairball graphs are prohibited as a primary reading mode.
Event Playback visually separates chronology from causality and never implies unsupported sequence, simultaneity or certainty.
Evidence visualizations keep the underlying citation/source retrievable; visual summaries never replace source access.
Quantitative charts require axes, units and provenance; missing values remain missing and estimates remain labeled.
Non-zero bar baselines, derived indices, normalization, aggregation or transformations are explicitly explained when they can materially change interpretation.
Historical maps differentiate documented, inferred, disputed and uncertain spatial claims using non-color-only treatments.
Unknown information is never visually interpolated into a known value, date, route, border or relationship.
Mobile layouts may reduce simultaneous density but cannot remove provenance, uncertainty, relationship type or factual context.
All factual meaning survives reduced motion; animation is explanatory enhancement only.
Important visualizations provide a concise textual summary or accessible data representation, and interactive elements expose reachable details.
Every visualization answers a defined editorial question; walls of charts, generic KPI-dashboard layouts and decorative pseudo-historical graphics are prohibited.

decision.condition: include the twelve production rules above in the locked baseline
